name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill, 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester, next to LAX), since 1952
Happy hour is 3-6 every day
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos, $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3
Every week: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia, every game on the TVs
Melody Rewards is free and gives 100 welcome points
Earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip)
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year
Refer a friend: +100 points when they join with your code and make a first visit
Rewards: 250 pts soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entrée
One reward per day per member, no stacking, never free alcohol
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it
Just Landed: 10% off your first order with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours
Melody Approach is a free flying game with a Campaign board and a Survival board; both reset every Monday
Game prizes are in BETA: boards are live for bragging rights, prizes switch on soon
Games Pack: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix, Truth or Dare
Order from your phone: pick table, bar, patio or to go, then pay your server like normal
No app download needed; add it to your Home Screen
Melody and sister spot Nalu Vida (Venice Pier) have separate points balances
Free parking; about a 15-minute walk from LAX terminals
LAX crew get 10% off with a badge (dine-in)
Private events for 10-150 guests; catering and DoorDash delivery available
Location bonus: +100 points once for opening the app with location and notifications on across 3 days

qa.a: We're open Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.

qa.q: What time does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen's closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: When do you open on weekends?
qa.a: Weekends we open at 9 AM, and weekend brunch runs 9 AM to 3 PM. Call (310) 670-1994 if you want to double-check.
We're at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester right by LAX. Tap Directions in the app for a map.
Call us at (310) 670-1994, or tap Call in the app.
Yes, we have free parking, including a free lot for people picking up travelers.
Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. We're also only about 5 minutes away by car.
Tap the Directions button in the Visit Melody section of the app.
Happy hour is 3 to 6 PM every day. Ask staff for the current happy hour drink and food deals.

qa.q: Is happy hour on weekends too?
qa.a: Yes, the app lists happy hour as 3-6 daily.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3.
Monday is half off burgers, 11 AM to 3 PM.
Yes! Tuesdays 11 AM to midnight: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas.
Classic tacos at $4 each: Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas.
The $6.99 elevated tacos are the Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, Smash Burger Taco and Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco. Tuesdays only.

qa.q: Can I order Taco Tuesday tacos on other days?
qa.a: No, the Taco Tuesday tacos can only be added on Tuesdays. Other days see the regular Tacos & Burritos menu.
Thursday is half off sandwiches, 11 AM to 3 PM.
Friday is $3 sliders, 11 AM to 3 PM.
The app doesn't list a Wednesday food special. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Every week we have karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
Karaoke is weekly, usually Wednesday nights starting around 10 PM. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.
Trivia is on our weekly lineup, but I don't have the night or time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Yes, we show every game on the TVs. The app's Sports section also shows live scores for LA and California teams.
Most events, including game watch parties and happy hour, have no cover. I don't have cover info for late DJ nights, so please call (310) 670-1994.
Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask about reservations.
Yes, for 10 to 150 guests, with indoor space, a patio and a private party room with a pool table. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: Do you do catering or delivery?
qa.a: Yes, we offer catering and delivery through DoorDash. Call (310) 670-1994 about catering.
Yes, there's a patio. You can pick Patio when you order from your phone.

qa.q: Is there a discount for airport workers?
qa.a: Yes, LAX crew get 10% off with a badge, dine-in. It can't be combined with other promos.
Just got off a flight? Show your boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours and get 10% off your first order today.

qa.q: How do I use Just Landed?
qa.a: Tap I just landed in the app, then show the code and your boarding pass to your server. One per guest per day, and it can't be combined with other offers.
It's our free rewards program. Earn points on every check and from games, and carry your gold Melody Rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Joining is free and takes about 10 seconds. Tap the join option in the app and you get 100 welcome points.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, it's free. One account per person.

qa.q: How many points do I get when I join?
qa.a: You get 100 welcome points once, when you join.
Earn 10 points for every $1 on eligible purchases (before tip). You can also earn from birthdays, referrals and games.
10 points per $1 spent on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app and snap your receipt, or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). One receipt per day, each check once, up to $150 per check.

qa.q: Is there a limit on receipts?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check can be used once, and up to $150 per check counts. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report.

qa.q: What purchases are eligible for points?
qa.a: I don't have the full list of what counts. Ask staff if you're unsure about something specific.
No, points are earned on purchases before tip.
I don't have expiration details. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter. 1,500 pts: free entrée.

qa.q: What does the 250-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free soft drink or Melody Fries for 250 points.

qa.q: What does the 500-point reward get me?
qa.a: $10 off your check for 500 points.

qa.q: What does the 1,000-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free starter: Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: What does the 1,500-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free entrée up to $21.50: any Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. Your next code comes on your next visit.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day, with no stacking. A second prize that day shows Come back tomorrow.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No, rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my points to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.
The app doesn't list membership levels. You just earn points and pick rewards from the reward list.
Yes, you get +250 points once a year on your birthday as a Melody Rewards member.

qa.q: How do I refer a friend?
qa.a: Tap Text a friend on your member card to send your invite link. When your friend joins with your code and makes a first visit, you get +100 points and they get 100 welcome points.

qa.q: When do I get my referral points?
qa.a: Referral points pay once per friend, after their first visit.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's referral code later?
qa.a: No. You enter one friend's code once when you join, and it can't be changed later. You can't use your own code.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for location or early visits?
qa.a: There's a one-time +100 Location buddy bonus: open the app with location and notifications on at least 3 different days spanning 7 days. It's added automatically.
It's optional. If you turn it on and open the app within about half a mile of Melody, you'll see a You're nearby deal. Nothing turns on without your tap and your phone's permission.
Only if you turn it on, and only while the app is open. It's never sold, shared or used for ads. You can turn it off in the app or your phone settings.
App visit info is seen only by the restaurant's owner and SousShift AI, and it's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: Can I earn points from games?
qa.a: Game rewards are in BETA and currently off, so no game points are given yet. When they switch on, you can earn up to 50 game points a day.
It's our free arcade flying game over LA, with a Campaign mode and a Survival mode. Play with or without an account.

qa.q: How do I play Melody Approach?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and your plane glides to your finger. Tap the ⚡ button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.
10 levels of about 45 seconds each along a real SoCal route, with six boss fights (levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10), then a landing at LAX. Your score counts.
There's no finish line. The game keeps getting harder until your plane goes down, and your time survived is what counts.

qa.q: How do I score in the game?
qa.a: Shoot down jets, UFOs, choppers and bosses, and catch Melody's food and music notes. Dodge enemy fire; every attack is warned first.

qa.q: How does health work in the game?
qa.a: Three hits and your plane goes down, and the game is over.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, which use limited ammo you refill by catching ammo crates.
Yes. Pause and tap the ⚔️ button to switch to a calm flight with no combat.
Melody Approach is free to play as often as you like.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two weekly boards, Campaign (by score) and Survival (by longest time survived). Both reset every Monday. Tap Post my score after a flight.

qa.q: Do practice flights count on the board?
qa.a: No, practice and test flights don't go on the boards. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: What do I win on the weekly board?
qa.a: Right now the game is in BETA, so boards are for bragging rights only. Once prizes switch on, the top player on each board may win the weekly prize shown in the game, such as free Melody Fries.
Boards reset every Monday, but prizes aren't switched on yet. Ask staff for how winners will be contacted.
Melody Games has Trivia, Sports Trivia, Truth or Dare, the daily Melody Word and Melody Mix. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.
Answer 10 multiple-choice questions on music, food & drink, pop culture or LA. Faster right answers score more. Play solo or pass the phone with 2-6 players.
Pick your favorite team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a 1-5 star Fan Rating, or play mixed LA sports questions.
One daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints, and a new word comes every day at midnight LA time.
A word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out; you get 3 skips.
A table game for 1-6 players with light truths and fun dares. It's just for fun, with no points. Dares never involve drinking and anyone can pass.

qa.q: How many points can I earn from the Games Pack?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and the daily word 3 points (fewer with hints). Max 10 Games Pack points a day.
Yes, the Who wins? picks are free and just for fun, with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts. Once rewards are on, a right pick earns 2 points, up to 6 a day.
Yes, the LA Scoreboard shows live scores from ESPN for LA and California teams. It's for information only, with no streams. Game cards also link to where to watch.
Yes. Members get 1 free square per board by tapping Get my free square, with extra squares if you buy something (ask staff). There's no entry fee, and prizes are shown on each board.
Yes, kid mode hides games meant for adults. I don't have more detail, so ask staff if you have questions.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: Scan your table's QR code, or pick your spot (table number, bar, patio or to go), add items, and tap Send my order. Then pay your server or bartender like normal.

qa.q: What if I scanned a table code?
qa.a: Your table is already picked, so you can start adding items right away.
Pay your server or bartender like normal. You still earn points on every check.
Yes, pick To go when ordering from your phone and we'll text you when it's ready.

qa.q: Can I order at the bar?
qa.a: Yes, pick I'm at the bar and your bartender gets your order as soon as you send it.

qa.q: What food is on the menu?
qa.a: The app lists Starters, Mac & Cheese, a Melody Burger, Fries, Soups, Tacos & Burritos, plus Taco Tuesday tacos on Tuesdays. Scroll the Menu tab to see everything.

Lemon Pepper Wings ($16), Avocado Toast ($13), BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites ($15), Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries ($16), Chicken Pot Stickers ($15), Fried Green Beans ($13), Fried Shrimp ($18.25), Jalapeno Calamari ($16), Lettuce Wraps ($16) and Baby Back Ribs & Fries ($20.25).

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: Lobster ($21.50), Melody Burger ($19.25), Bacon, Cheddar & Jalapeno ($17.25), Chicken Parmesan ($18.25), Parmesan & Mushroom ($17.25) and House Mac ($15).

qa.q: Tell me about the Melody Burger.
qa.a: Grilled Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries. It's $19.25.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos are on the regular menu?
qa.a: Tacos (2 per order): Shrimp $16, Salmon $16, Carnitas $14, Beyond $14, Chicken $13, Avocado $13. Burritos: Steak and Carnitas $18.25, Chicken $17.25, Bean & Cheese $14. Also Nachos $15 and Cheese Quesadilla $15.
Gilroy Garlic Fries $6.75, Melody Fries $5.75, Onion Strings $9.75, Phat Fries $7.75, Philly Cheese Steak Fries $17.25 and Sweet Potato Fries $7.75. Add cheese +$2 on Melody and Phat Fries.
French Onion, Tomato Bisque (cup $11, bowl $15) and Black Bean (cup $9.75, bowl $14).

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
qa.a: The app lists the Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, Vegan Carnitas Taco (Tuesdays), Fried Green Beans and Black Bean Soup. Ask staff about ingredients and allergies.
Mango Margarita, House Margarita, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, Draft Beer, Mimosa, Round of Shots and a Bucket of Beers (5).
Drink prices in the app are previews until Melody confirms them, so ask your server or bartender for current prices. House Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays.

qa.q: Do you have real photos of the food?
qa.a: Yes, tap the Real Photos tag on some menu items, or the gallery after the food menu. Some dishes also have a Spin in 3D button.

qa.q: What languages does the app have?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages. If you can't find the language setting, ask staff.

qa.q: Do I need to download the app?
qa.a: No download needed. It opens in your phone's browser, from the QR code on your table or the link in our Instagram bio, and you can add it to your Home Screen.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my Home Screen?
qa.a: Use your phone browser's Share or menu button and choose Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, notifications need the Home Screen version (iOS 16.4 or newer).
Tap My Rewards Card in the app for your card ID, points, next reward and QR code. Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't turned on yet.

qa.q: Do my points work at Nalu Vida?
qa.a: No. Melody and Nalu Vida (Venice Pier) each have their own points balance, and points don't move between them.

qa.q: Who can I ask for help in the app?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: I have a question that isn't answered here.
qa.a: Please ask any staff member or call us at (310) 670-1994.
